sample.title: Crystal Drake
sample.description: A subterranean celestial dragon found deep within crystalline caverns. Emits high-energy resonant pulses that alter nearby gravity.
sample.author: Etherium Developer Team
behaviorBullets: Aggressive when approached within 12 blocks or attacked.
Launches homing crystalline shards that pierce dragon armor.
Can summon crystal spires from the cavern ceiling during combat.
Immune to fire, lava, and blast damage.

gallery.title: In-Game Render
gallery.caption: Crystal Drake in its subterranean nest

sections.title: Overview & Lore
sections.content: The **Crystal Drake** was introduced in Etherium v1.4.0 as a subterranean mini-boss residing deep within the Crystal Caverns biome.

sections.title: Combat Mechanics
sections.content: When fighting a Crystal Drake, keep distance during its **Resonant Burst** attack. Using netherite shields can absorb up to 80% of shard projectile impact.
